{{Quote|Freedon Nadd. for years I worshiped your name. For a lifetime I served the memory of your dark power. Now, in the name of my husband King Ommin, in the name of his ancestor ''Freedon Nadd'', I call down the power of the ''dark side'' upon these foes!|Queen Amanoa, invoking the power of Freedon Nadd|audio=InvokeSpirits1-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
'''Invoke spirits''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] conjured through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], that summoned the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of a [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[darksider]], usually to augment the requesting [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith sorcerer|magician]] with the deceased's power.

==Description==
{{Quote|I call upon the spirit of Freedon Nadd&hellip;May his dark power fill me now!|Amanoa|audio=InvokeSpirits2-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
Users of this ability would fully surrender themselves to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and summon a particular [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]]. The caster then would request to be endowed with the power of the spirit, becoming filled with a palpable hatred that overwhelmed anyone in proximity. The potency of these rituals could be amplified, should the user be in the vicinity of the physical remains of the spirit whose power was solicited.<ref name="BWOO2" />

==History==
During the [[Battle of Iziz|last battle]] of the [[Beast Wars]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] exercised this ability against the armies of the [[Beast-Lord]] [[Modon Kira]]. Petitioning both the ancient spirit of the dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]] and the power of [[Ommin/Legends|her living husband]], Amanoa enveloped both the Jedi and the [[Beast Riders]] of Onderon in [[Waves of darkness|waves of utter darkness]]. Immediately the affected were weighed down by the dark side, experiencing feelings of total confusion and despair. [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] and the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were crushed by a great sense of oppression and fear, so strong it nearly snuffed out their own connections to the Force. It was not until the arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] that the power of Nadd's influence was lifted. Through Jeth's [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]], the Jedi's resolve was renewed along with the Beast Riders, who eventually overcame the dark-side warriors of Iziz. Afterward, when Master Jeth stormed the hidden [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]] with Jedi and Beast Riders in tow, they found Amanoa there, drawing fully on the source of her power. However, in Jeth's presence the darkness could no longer endure; Amanoa's power waned as Freedon Nadd's influence was driven out by the [[Force Light|invoked light]] of the Jedi. In her [[Galia|daughter's]] arms, the Queen of Onderon joined her evil ancestors in death.<ref name="TOTJA" />

Palpatine used this power, learned from Sith Holocrons, to talk to spirits of old Sith in order to develop his powers of conjuring dark energies, most notably lightning.<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>
